verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Shared Drives, network storage accessible from multiple machines in a private network. It also documents shared persistent storage for Notebooks, which implies the data is decoupled from any single instance. However, the evidence is a single sentence per feature and never states that data survives deleting a machine, nor how drives are attached or mounted. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that shared drives persist after machine teardown, attach/mount workflow details, capacity/performance specifics, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach persistent network storage that survives instance teardown, so datasets and checkpoints outlive any single GPU rental

citations.quote: Shared drives provide storage that is accessible from multiple machines in a private network.
